claims: Apollo 13 held the record for the farthest distance humans have traveled from Earth from 1970 until April 6, 2026.
Apollo 13 reached 248,655 miles (400,171 km) from Earth.
The Apollo 13 crew achieved the record on April 15, 1970.
An oxygen tank failure forced the Apollo 13 crew on a long free-return trajectory around the far side of the moon to return safely.
Apollo 13 astronauts were Jim Lovell, Jack Swigert, and Fred Haise.
The Apollo 13 mission lasted 5 days, 22 hours, and 54 minutes.
Apollo 13 was a successful failure mission.
The NASA Artemis II mission broke the Apollo 13 record on April 6, 2026.
The Orion spacecraft passed 248,655 miles from Earth during the NASA Artemis II mission.
The Orion spacecraft reached a maximum distance of 252,756 miles (406,778 km) from Earth during its lunar flyby
